Engram::Architect3 (session-14548) no longer exists. Nobody routes work or Greg's directions through it.

Its earlier relays and memory edits are not authoritative on their own. Check them against Greg's direct words, as recorded in rules-greg-control revision 25. For example, it recorded the reversed "retired, legacy kept for compatibility" text, which revision 25 voids.
